text:
sam: spotted oddity in invoice preview for APAC tenants after yesterday's routing policy toggle. preview shows ~1.9% more tokens attributed to `fallback-route`.

ravi: which toggle? the route-priority change that biases low-latency backends?

sam: yes, rolled 03:40 UTC. final invoices match, but preview per-route breakdown is noisy for ~8-15s windows.

liz: can you paste a redacted event?

sam: redacted sample:
```
event_id: ev_aa12, ts: 1774209312, tenant: apac-x, session: s_11, route_tag: null, tokens: 76
```
then finalizer shows same session with route_tag: search-fast and tokens 76.

metering-bot: scan: 31 preview events with null route_tag in apac between 1774209300..1774209400 flagged as routed->fallback by preview consumer.

ravi: my hunch: preview consumer still reading pre-enriched topic while finalizer reads enriched stream; the route-priority toggle moved enrichment ordering.

sam: yep. customers not billed incorrectly but CS saw preview and opened 2 tickets.

liz: short-term: show a small warning on preview card and flip preview consumer to enriched topic as a canary in APAC.

product-bot: suggested UI text: "Preview may be temporarily inconsistent during routing rollouts; final invoices remain authoritative." (ok?)

ravi: ok for canary. will target single partition for 30m. sre-bot please help.

sre-bot: deploy started: preview-consumer->read-enriched.canary.apac partition-1 (sha: d4f2).

metering-bot: alert: preview_vs_final_delta.apac = 2.1% at 1774209350.

sam: canary result: delta dropped 2.1% -> 0.2% within 6m after switching topic.

liz: promote if stable 30m, and add a `preview_confidence` boolean to preview API payload. product-bot: will propose tooltip copy and feature flag.

ravi: follow-ups: (1) short-term: promote canary region-wide (2) medium-term: design doc to unify enrichment placement or guarantee enriched stream is primary for all preview consumers (3) add dashboard alarm to ignore tagged deploy windows.

sam: I've opened ticket MET-9022 "apac preview attribution drift after routing-priority toggle" assigned sam/ravi/liz. linking grafana: https://grafana.internal/d/preview/apac-delta-1774

liz: drafting CS reply with reconcile SQL: `SELECT session_id, SUM(tokens) FROM preview_events WHERE ts>=t0 GROUP BY session_id JOIN final_ledger USING(session_id) WHERE preview_sum != final_sum;`

sam: canary stable at 31m, promoting region-wide now. leaving preview banner until we complete design doc. no billing impact.

ravi: thanks — add postmortem note to the rollout doc and schedule enrichment placement sync next week.

sam: closing thread. :thumbsup:
